extDescription.message: Unlimited new-tab shortcut grid with Google account sync, 100-step version history, search, and single-file photo backup.

searchPlaceholder.message: Find shortcuts · Search web · Go to URL

emptyGuide.message: No shortcuts yet. If Chrome Sync is turned on, shortcuts from your other devices will appear shortly.

editNamePlaceholder.message: Leave blank to use domain name

photoNoticeTitle.message: Background photos stay on this device only

photoNoticeBody1.message: Due to Chrome Sync's 100 KB quota, photos are not synced across devices. Devices without a local photo show the gradient background instead.

photoNoticeBody2.message: To use the same photo on another device, pick it there or transfer it with a backup file.

introWelcomeTitle.message: New here, or bringing existing settings?

introNewDesc.message: Pick your theme, background, and label legibility while previewing live behind this card.

introExistingTitle.message: I have settings on another device or a backup file

introExistingDesc.message: Bring over your shortcuts and settings via Google Account Sync or a backup file.

introThemeDesc.message: Sets the brightness of the search bar, dialogs, and gradient background. Changes apply immediately.

introBgTypeDesc.message: Choose a background style first, then customize its details next.

introBgGradientDesc.message: Crafted from your accent color and composition. Syncs across devices.

introBgColorDesc.message: Fills the screen with a single color. Syncs across devices.

introBgImageDesc.message: Uses an image file from your computer. Stored on this device only.

noteColorContrast.message: Shortcut label text switches automatically between white and dark ink for contrast.

introPhotoOrigin.message: Already saved on this device (picked earlier or imported from a backup file).

notePhotoLocal.message: Photos stay on this device only and are not synced to your Google account.

introLegibilityDesc.message: Choose how shortcut labels stay readable over your background.

introSyncDesc.message: If Chrome Sync is on with the same Google account as your other device, shortcuts and settings will arrive shortly (excluding photos).

introBackupDesc.message: Have a backup file exported from Settings → Backup? Import it here to restore photos too.

noteGradientSync.message: Adapts to your theme, accent color, and composition, and syncs across devices.

notePhotoMissing.message: 'My photo' was selected on another device, so gradient is shown here instead. Pick a photo on this device or import a backup file.

noteSearchOrder.message: Pressing Enter twice in the search bar runs the top group immediately.

labelAutoSync.message: Sync automatically across devices on this account

noteSyncScope.message: Shortcuts, custom icons, and display settings sync automatically. Background photos stay on this device due to quota limits.

noteSyncIconsOmitted.message: Custom icons exceeded the 100 KB sync quota. Some icon images stay local; other devices show default site icons.

noteSyncTrimmed.message: Older history entries on this device were trimmed to stay within the 100 KB sync quota.

noteHistoryDesc.message: Every shortcut or setting change saves a checkpoint. Up to 100 checkpoints per device sync to your account so you can roll back anytime. Photos are excluded.

noteBackupScope.message: Backup files include shortcuts, custom icons, display settings, and your background photo.

backupSafetyNote.message: Export backup files periodically to keep an extra copy of important shortcuts. Backup (.json) files store shortcut URLs and photos in unencrypted plain text—keep them private on shared devices.

errNoValidShortcuts.message: No valid shortcuts found to import.

errForeignBackup.message: This file is not a Tileshelf backup.

importSummaryWithPhoto.message: This backup contains {0}. 'Replace all' overwrites your settings and background photo, while 'Append to current list' keeps current settings and adds shortcuts at the end. Photos stay on this device only.

importSummaryNoPhoto.message: This backup contains {0}. 'Replace all' overwrites your settings, while 'Append to current list' keeps current settings and adds shortcuts at the end.

toastSyncTooBig.message: Exceeded the 100 KB sync quota. Reduce shortcuts or use a backup file.

toastSyncOverwrote.message: Updated with newer changes from another device · {0} shortcuts

toastSyncApplied.message: Synced changes from another device · {0} shortcuts

toastForeignHistory.message: Found a separate history started on another device · {0} shortcuts

toastLocalFileBlocked.message: Chrome blocked opening this local file directly. Copy the address and paste it into the address bar.

toastSettingsAnytime.message: You can change settings anytime from the gear button at the top right

legNoteShadow.message: Keeps the background untouched and adds a soft shadow behind labels. Bright photos or intense highlights may still reduce contrast.

legNoteDim.message: Places a translucent veil over the background (white in light-theme gradients). Tuned so labels stay legible over bright photos; lower the slider below to reveal more background.

legNoteDimIntro.message: Places a translucent veil over the background (white in light-theme gradients). Tuned so labels stay legible over bright photos; adjustable anytime in Settings.

legNoteCard.message: Wraps each icon and label inside a frosted card. Highest legibility across every background tested.

legNotePlain.message: On solid colors, label ink switches automatically for contrast unless Frosted card is selected.

motionBlockedReduced.message: Paused because your system's 'Reduce motion' setting is enabled.

motionBlockedNoGl.message: Paused because WebGL hardware acceleration is unavailable on this device.

motionHintOk.message: WebGL hardware acceleration is available for smooth animation.

motionHintSoftware.message: Running without GPU acceleration; keeping motion on will use CPU while a new tab is open.

motionHintBattery.message: Unplugged and battery is below 20%; keeping motion on uses extra battery while a new tab is open.

introSyncIdle.message: No synced data found yet. If you use Tileshelf on another device, wait a moment or click "Check now".

introSyncReceived.message: Loaded settings from another device · {0} shortcuts

introSyncOff.message: Sync is turned off on this device. You can enable it in Settings → Google Account Sync.

syncStatusEmpty.message: No data in account yet · Add a shortcut or import a backup to start syncing

syncStatusUploaded.message: Saved to account · Not yet fetched by another device

syncStatusTooBig.message: Exceeded the 100 KB account quota; cannot sync

orderMoveTitle.message: Drag or press Up/Down arrows to reorder

inspDialogDesc.message: Cleans up backgrounds, margins, and contrast on your custom icons only when displayed. Original images stay untouched—adjust them all at the top or individually below.

inspAutoIconHint.message: Only images you picked can be cleaned up. Set an image in the shortcut editor.

inspSummaryCount.message: {1} of {0} selected · Batch-edit above or configure each row individually.

toastIconEffectsApplied.message: Applied cleanup settings to {0} icon(s) (originals kept)

bakeDialogTitle.message: Overwrite original images with cleaned-up versions?

bakeDialogBody1.message: Currently, cleanup settings are calculated every time you open a new tab. Saving the current look directly as the image itself replaces the originals, skipping this calculation so new tabs open faster on slower computers.

bakeDialogBody2.message: However, the original images are deleted from this computer: removed backgrounds and cropped margins cannot be recovered, and contrast adjustments lock to your current theme's colors even if you switch themes later. If you miss the [Undo] button right after, restoring the originals is not guaranteed.
